item.title: SQUAD LIST | Wrexham AFC make updated 2025/26 submission
item.description: In line with EFL regulations, Wrexham AFC has submitted the following list of players aged 21 and older for its updated 2025/26 squad list. EFL regulations provide that all EFL Championship clubs can name 25 players aged 21 and older in the squad. This includes both goalkeepers and outfield players. We have opted to initially name 23 players at this stage, providing us with the option to add two extra players as needed. item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce that the Club have launched two Academy social media accounts. item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 0-2 Millwall
item.description: An own-goal and Josh Coburn’s late strike handed Wrexham defeat at the SToK Cae Ras, as the Red Dragons were beaten 2-0 in North Wales. Despite a strong start, the visitors broke the deadlock through a stroke of fortune from Femi Azeez’s cross with 59 minutes played. item.title: SIGNED | Sarah Harvey signs for Wrexham AFC Women
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women are delighted to announce the signing of Canadian defender Sarah Harvey on a deal until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. Harvey, 30, has played in England, Canada, Georgia and Hungary, alongside playing in the UEFA Women’s Champions League qualifiers during her time in Georgia. She grew up playing grassroots football, before moving into semi-professional football in League1, while still in Canada.
